A '''tranquilizer dart''' was a small non-lethal projectile designed to be launched from a wrist-mounted personal weapon system. This dart caused unconsciousness in a matter of seconds and was good for tagging [[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]] for research purposes, or stopping a fleeing bounty mark in their tracks. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mira]] was known to use this type of weapon towards the end of the [[Dark Wars]].

Tranquilizer darts were still used thousands of years later, in [[43 ABY]], by the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] to subdue members of their Order who had come down with an [[Force psychosis|engimatic madness]] which caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced with impostors.
